news.title: Augustana M.S. Applied Behavior Analysis Graduates Exceed National Certification Pass Rates
news.summary_en: TheMaster of Science in Applied Behavior Analysis (M.S. ABA)degree program at Augustana University is on a path toward national recognition and, ultimately, full accreditation. The M.S. ABA prepares students for the BCBA examination through a 5-semester, 19-month online program, which includes supervised fieldwork.
